summaries.text: This concurrent resolution authorizes the Capitol rotunda to be used on July 28, 2026, for a tribute to the late Senator Lindsey O. Graham of the state of South Carolina.

title: A concurrent resolution authorizing the use of the rotunda of the Capitol for a ceremony to honor the late Senator Lindsey O. Graham.
